reference_sql:
WITH days AS (
  -- one row per day, 3 to 9 March 2025
  SELECT CAST(range AS DATE) AS day
  FROM range(DATE '2025-03-03', DATE '2025-03-10', INTERVAL 1 DAY)
), running AS (
  -- one row per nonbrand search campaign running the whole week
  SELECT c.campaign_id
  FROM campaigns c
  JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id = c.channel_id
  WHERE ch.channel_name = 'nonbrand_search'
    AND c.start_date <= DATE '2025-03-03'
    AND c.end_date >= DATE '2025-03-09'
)
SELECT r.campaign_id, d.day, COALESCE(a.clicks, 0) AS clicks
FROM running r
CROSS JOIN days d
LEFT JOIN ad_spend_daily a ON a.campaign_id = r.campaign_id AND a.spend_date = d.day

), running AS (

  WHERE ch.channel_name = 'nonbrand_search'
    AND c.start_date <= DATE '2025-03-03'
    AND c.end_date >= DATE '2025-03-09'
)
SELECT r.campaign_id, d.day, COALESCE(SUM(a.clicks), 0) AS clicks
FROM days d

LEFT JOIN ad_spend_daily a ON a.spend_date = d.day AND a.campaign_id = r.campaign_id
GROUP BY r.campaign_id, d.day

WITH d AS (
  SELECT CAST(x AS DATE) AS day FROM generate_series(DATE '2025-03-03', DATE '2025-03-09', INTERVAL 1 DAY) t(x)
), c AS (
  SELECT cp.campaign_id FROM campaigns cp JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id = cp.channel_id
  WHERE ch.channel_name = 'nonbrand_search' AND cp.start_date <= DATE '2025-03-03' AND cp.end_date >= DATE '2025-03-09'
)
SELECT c.campaign_id, d.day, COALESCE(SUM(a.clicks), 0) AS clicks
FROM c CROSS JOIN d
LEFT JOIN ad_spend_daily a ON a.campaign_id = c.campaign_id AND a.spend_date = d.day
GROUP BY c.campaign_id, d.day
